name: Quantized Normal Shading via Pixel Texture
definition: A shading method for volume rendering that encodes surface normals into a 2D pixel texture to avoid hardware interpolation redundancy and truncation, using nearest-neighbor interpolation.
summary: Quantized Normal Shading via Pixel Texture is a hardware-accelerated volume rendering technique that encodes surface normals into a 2D pixel texture to avoid interpolation artifacts and truncation errors.
